checked_obligation: Verify from recurrence (6) that every term y_k is an odd positive integer.
reason: Simultaneous induction on (t_k,y_k) applies. Initially t_0=y_0=1 are odd and positive. If t_k and y_k are odd and positive, then t_{k+1}=2t_k+3y_k and y_{k+1}=t_k+2y_k are both odd and positive. Hence every y_k is odd and positive.
